2607.07047.title: Riemannian Geometry for Pre-trained Language Model Embeddings
2607.07047.paper_summary: Understanding the geometric structure of pre-trained language model embeddings matters for interpretability and safety. We ask whether sentence-level classification signal lives in the Riemannian geometry of contextual token embeddings, and probe it by extracting per-token pullback metrics from a learned encoder's analytical Jacobian and aggregating them with the Fréchet mean on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold; we call this procedure Riemannian Mean Pooling (RMP). Across three datasets with non-trivial linguistic structure (CoLA, CREAK, RTE), RMP outperforms Euclidean mean pooling, while on FEVER-Symmetric, a benchmark constructed to remove annotation-driven lexical artifacts, the method correctly stays at chance. Ablations show that a randomly initialised encoder combined with Fréchet aggregation already beats Euclidean pooling on two of the three signal-bearing datasets, localising the source of the gain to the geometric aggregation rather than to learned manifold structure; the trained encoder contributes additional signal specifically on CREAK, the most knowledge-heavy of the three signal-bearing datasets.
2607.07047.paper_summary_zh: 理解預訓練語言模型嵌入的幾何結構對於可解釋性和安全性至關重要。<lb/>我們詢問句子級分類信號是否存在於上下文標記嵌入的黎曼幾何中，並通過從學習的編碼器的解析雅可比矩陣中提取每個標記的回拉度量來探究它，並使用對稱正定（SPD）流形上的Fréchet均值進行聚合；我們稱這一過程為黎曼均值池化（RMP）。<lb/>在三個具有非平凡語言結構的數據集（CoLA、CREAK、RTE）中，RMP的表現優於歐幾里得均值池化，而在FEVER-Symmetric上，這是一個旨在消除標註驅動的詞彙工件的基準，該方法正確地保持在隨機水平。<lb/>消融實驗顯示，隨機初始化的編碼器結合Fréchet聚合已經在三個信號承載數據集中的兩個上超越了歐幾里得池化，將增益的來源定位於幾何聚合而非學習的流形結構；訓練的編碼器在CREAK上特別貢獻了額外的信號，該數據集是三個信號承載數據集中知識最重的。
